description: Registry for toolbar items. Items are ordered by Order and filtered by command availability.

members.name: GetAvailableItems
members.description: Returns items whose commands are available in the command registry. Items without a CommandName are always included. When no command registry is attached, all items are returned.

members.name: GetGroups
members.description: Returns groups sorted by tab and order.

members.name: GetItems
members.description: Returns all registered items sorted by Order.

members.name: Register
members.description: Registers a toolbar item. Can be called by host application to add custom items.

members.name: RegisterGroup
members.description: Registers a toolbar group used for ordering and overflow grouping.
